entries.title: AWS Bedrock
entries.description: Managed service providing access to foundation models from leading AI companies including Anthropic Claude, Meta Llama, and Amazon Titan. Offers model customization, guardrails, and knowledge bases with enterprise-grade security and compliance.

entries.title: Azure AI Foundry
entries.description: Microsoft's managed platform for designing, building and running generative AI applications. Combines model catalog, multi-agent orchestration, managed compute and governance capabilities with private networking and enterprise security.

entries.title: A2A
entries.description: Agent-to-Agent communication framework for building systems where AI agents can interact and collaborate with each other.

entries.title: LangGraph
entries.description: Framework for building stateful, multi-actor applications with large language models. Provides tools for creating complex workflows and agent systems with state management.

entries.title: RAG
entries.description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation - A framework for enhancing large language models by retrieving relevant information from external knowledge bases to improve response accuracy and relevance.

entries.title: Agentic Workflows
entries.description: Design patterns and methodologies for creating autonomous AI agents that can perform complex tasks with minimal human intervention, including planning, execution, and self-correction.

entries.title: Structured Prompting
entries.description: Systematic approach to designing prompts with clear structure, formatting, and instructions to improve AI model performance and consistency in responses.

entries.title: Meta Prompting
entries.description: Advanced prompting technique where AI models are instructed to generate, refine, or optimize prompts themselves, creating a meta-level approach to prompt engineering.

entries.title: Context Engineering
entries.description: Discipline focused on optimising the context provided to AI models, including context window management, information architecture, and relevance optimisation for improved model performance.
